L8 `import { useUnits } from '@/hooks/useUnits'` -> a scoped native useUnits() exposing the consumed formatDistance + formatSpeed. It reads the web-parity useSettings() and derives distance ('km' default, 'mi' when unit_of_length === 'mi'), speed ('km/h' default, 'mph' when unit_of_length === 'mi'), locale (trimmed string else 'en-US'), and precision (floored non-negative finite decimal_precision else undefined) — exactly the web useUnits derivations. formatDistance mirrors web/src/lib/unitConversion.ts: non-finite -> '—'; digits = resolvePrecision(pref, override, fallback 1); convertDistanceFromSI (km = m/1000, mi = m/1609.344); returns `${localeNumber} ${distance}`. formatSpeed: non-finite -> '—'; digits fallback 0; convertSpeedFromSI (km/h = mps*3600/1000, mph = mps*3600/1609.344); returns `${localeNumber} ${speed}`. The web DistanceUnitPref 'ft' arm is unreachable from unit_of_length, so the native unions narrow to 'km'|'mi' and 'km/h'|'mph'. Memoised over (distance/speed, locale, precision) like the web hook.
